title: "Facial Expression Model Audit"

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Status: in progress**
:::

| | |
|---|---|
| **Question** | How well does a public facial expression classifier work on data it was not trained on? |
| **Approach** | Evaluate the model on external data **without retraining**, then diagnose where errors come from |
| **Key finding** | Most of the low initial accuracy came from a preprocessing mismatch. Changing only the input crop raised accuracy from **22.6% to 45.3%**. |
| **Tools** | Python, Hugging Face, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Streamlit |
| **Code** | [github.com/jhwn223/facial-expression-analysis](https://github.com/jhwn223/facial-expression-analysis) |
